Thanks for the details, Elena — and welcome aboard. A couple quick items to close out on our side: 

1) We do need a completed W-9 (vendor tax form) before we can finalize vendor setup. Can you send that to finance@redwoodinference.com or attach here?

2) For remittance mapping: Redwood's payops system ingests an ACH remittance reference string and looks for two tokenized fields when a PO is present: PO=<po_number> and INV=<invoice_number>. If the remittance reference includes those tokens (example: "PO=12345;INV=2027-338"), our accounting automation will auto-apply the payment to the correct PO and invoice. If you prefer a pipe-delimited string like INV-2027-338|PO-12345 we can add a small parsing rule, but the tokenized form above is the most reliable.

3) We'll run micro-deposits to the account you provided and confirm amounts. Once you verify the micro-deposits we will flip the vendor to "active" and schedule the first payout.

I've looped in Aditya from Finance to coordinate the micro-deposit timing and acceptance steps. Marissa, FYI for PO tagging and any procurement-side fields we should require on invoices.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
